# Vendored figure data — Becker (2026)

Computed output behind the figures in *The Microstructure of Wealth Transfer in
Prediction Markets*, copied verbatim from
[Jon-Becker/research](https://github.com/Jon-Becker/research)
(`papers/prediction-market-microstructure/fig/`), MIT licensed,
Copyright (c) 2021 Jonathan Becker.

Vendored so `published_cells.py` and its tests reproduce without a 36GiB
download. These are aggregate per-price series, not the underlying trade data.

| file | |
|---|---|
| `longshot_ev_asymmetry.json` | pooled YES/NO returns by price — the headline series |
| `maker_win_rate_by_direction.json` | maker win rate by side and cost basis |
| `mispricing_by_price.json` | taker / maker / combined mispricing by price |
| `yes_vs_no_by_price_taker_maker.json` | volume share by role and side |
| `yes_no_asymmetry_significance.csv` | per-price win rates, EVs, n, and p-values |
